name: BaseLevel.charpoly_mem_heckeAlgebra
summary: The coefficient is a(g)^(N−i) times the coefficient for ρ_x(g); the Hecke algebra is a closed subalgebra, and the coefficient for ρ_x(g) is a limit, along most Frobenius data, of ι of the coefficients of the Hecke polynomials at places off level, which are integers times Hecke eigenvalues; the eigenvalue function acts on forms of level L as the Hecke operator T_{w,j}, which preserves integral forms.

steps.claim: By hN, N_x(g) = a(g)·ρ_x(g), and the coefficient of X^i in the characteristic polynomial of λM is λ^{N−i} times that of M (charpoly_smul_coeff): the function is a(g)^{N−i}·(x ↦ coeff_i charpoly ρ_x(g)).
The Hecke algebra is an O-subalgebra containing the scalar a(g)^{N−i}; it remains that x ↦ coeff_i charpoly ρ_x(g) lies in it.
steps.lean:
refine mul_mem (pow_mem (algebraMap_mem _ (a g)) _) (isClosed_heckeAlgebra.mem_of_tendsto
    (tendsto_pi_nhds.2 (·.2.elim fun _ ⟨m, h⟩ ↦ (Isotypic.attached_galRep m.1
    h).tendsto_charpoly_coeff ..)) (Filter.mem_inf_of_left (eventually_mostFrobenii
    (D.eventually_isOffLevel (L := L)) fun w ⟨_, _, k, h⟩ ↦ ?_)))

steps.claim: The Hecke algebra is closed in the functions on eigensystems (isClosed_heckeAlgebra). For every eigensystem x (with a nonzero form in it) ρ_x is attached to the Hecke polynomials of x (Isotypic.attached_galRep), so coeff_i charpoly ρ_x(g) is the limit, along most Frobenius data (w, …) with Frobenius tending to g, of ι_ℓ of the coefficient of X^i of the Hecke polynomial of x at w (Attached.tendsto_charpoly_coeff); it suffices that these functions of x lie in the Hecke algebra for most Frobenius data.

All but finitely many places are off level for D at L (eventually_isOffLevel), so it suffices to treat a Frobenius datum at a place w off level: w ∤ ℓ (k) and the forms of level L of each eigensystem are spherical eigenforms at w with its eigenvalues (h).

The coefficient of X^i of the Hecke polynomial at w is an integer (a sign times a power of q_w) times the j-th Hecke eigenvalue of x at w; the goal is that this integer times x ↦ ι_ℓ(t_{x,w,j}) is in the Hecke algebra.

The integer is a scalar; and x ↦ ι_ℓ(t_{x,w,j}) lies in the Hecke algebra because its operator (multiplication by ι_ℓ⁻¹ of it on each eigensystem, diagOp) agrees on formsOfLevel(D, L) with the Hecke operator T_{w,j} (heckeSplit; w is split as q_w is prime): this is checked on each eigensystem, whose forms are eigenforms of T_{w,j} with eigenvalue t_{x,w,j} (formsOfLevel_le_of_eigensystem, diagOp_apply); and T_{w,j} lies in the local group algebra at w (heckeFun_mem_localGroupAlgebra), which preserves integral forms since w ∤ ℓ (localGroupAlgebra_le_endPreserving).
steps.lean:
exact mul_mem (intCast_mem ..) fun y e ↦ (formsOfLevel_le_of_eigensystem (N :=
    (heckeSplit (V.formTranslation κ) (isSplit_of_q_prime w.prime_q) _).eqLocus (diagOp _))
    (fun x f m ↦ by simp [diagOp_apply _ x m.1, by simpa [eigenformsAt] using h _ x.2 m]; rfl)
    y.2).subst (localGroupAlgebra_le_endPreserving k (heckeFun_mem_localGroupAlgebra _ (.id _)) _ e)
